summary: Phase 21 testing complete. Backend: 5/5 pytest passed (week-at-a-glance returns scoring_format+opponent for H2H / omits opponent for non-H2H; PUT /api/leagues/{id}/teams/{id}/awards sets & clears championship_won_at / division_winner_at / playoffs_reached_at and returns unlocked_trades; non-commissioner gets 403; admin-triggered conditional trade with won_championship=eq=1 flips to 'executed' and unlocked_trades=1 when PUT awards fires). Frontend: DashboardPage shows data-testid='my-leagues-ordered' with 5 draggable rows (draggable=true) for chriszarek, '5 LEAGUES' badge, 'Open' link with ArrowRight icon pointing to /leagues/{id}. Drag-drop via Playwright drag_to reorders rows and PERSISTS to localStorage key 'dd_league_order_v1'. No 'HEAD TO_HEAD' text on /dashboard, /leagues, /leagues/{id}; all render as 'HEAD TO HEAD'. My Week at a Glance shows opponent section ('WEEK 1 MATCHUP · VS {name}' + 'THIS WK {score}' + Winning/Losing badge with delta) for H2H cards (Ice Kings, Frozen Dynasty, Perennial Keepers) and HIDES opponent section for non-H2H cards (Stat Chasers Roto, Set-and-Forget Best Ball). Commissioner Settings → League Administration main tab → Season Awards sub-tab (data-testid='admin-tab-season-awards') renders 12 team rows × 3 switches (Playoffs/Division/Champion = 36 total). /analytics: 0 width(-1)/height(-1) warnings in console (2 total warnings, none recharts-related).

integration_issues.issue: After clicking a toggle switch on Season Awards tab, a toast was not detectable via [role=status]/.toast/[data-sonner-toast] selectors within 2.5s. The backend PUT endpoint works correctly (verified by pytest), so the wiring is likely fine — could be a fast-dismissing toast or non-standard portal. Worth confirming visually that the toast actually appears with correct unlocked_trades copy.

action_items: (Low-priority) Verify that toasts on SeasonAwardsTab actually render and include the unlocked_trades count copy when >0 — E1 can self-verify by clicking a toggle in the browser.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~4640 lines — still a single-file monolith. Recommend splitting by domain (routers/trades.py, routers/awards.py, routers/leagues.py) before further growth. Flagged in prior iterations too.
PUT /api/leagues/{id}/teams/{id}/awards uses $unset with empty-string value when clearing — MongoDB treats any value in $unset the same but using an explicit null/empty dict convention is cleaner.
MyLeaguesOrderedList ORDER_KEY 'dd_league_order_v1' is shared across users on same browser — fine for per-browser UX but consider scoping by user_id if multiple users share a device (minor).
Conditional trade re-evaluation on PUT awards swallows all exceptions silently (except Exception: pass). Log with league_id/trade_id so comm can debug why a trade did NOT unlock.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on review-request acceptance criteria (all 8 items verified)
